items.title: MC1187781: Viva Engage: Community feeds improvements
items.summary: Viva Engage communities will default to viewing conversations by recent posts instead of recent activity, with unread indicators in both "new" and "all" feeds. This change, rolling out November 2026, offers a sticky user preference for feed and sort order, improving content browsing without requiring action.

items.summary: Draft Mode for official Brand Kits in Microsoft 365 apps allows Brand Managers to create and review changes without affecting the live kit until published. It rolls out worldwide from late October to early November 2026. No action is required, but informing Brand Managers is recommended.

items.title: MC1530951: Microsoft PowerPoint: Assess templates for use with Copilot in Brand Kits
items.summary: Microsoft PowerPoint's new Template Assessment in Brand Kits helps Brand Managers evaluate and improve templates for better Copilot compatibility, requiring a Microsoft 365 Copilot (Premium) license. It rolls out worldwide from mid to late October 2026. No action needed; organizations should inform Brand Managers.

items.summary: Microsoft Teams will require explicit consent via phone keypad for PSTN participants in one-to-one calls when recording or transcription starts, beginning early December 2026. Participants can consent or decline; those who decline remain muted. This uses existing calling policies with no new settings introduced.

items.summary: Microsoft Teams will allow users to start one-to-one or small-group side conversations within the meeting chat window starting early December 2026. This feature keeps chats in context without leaving the meeting, preserves chat history, requires no admin action, and has no identified compliance issues.

items.title: MC1519843: New Outlook for Windows: All Accounts view brings email into a single inbox view
items.summary: The new Outlook for Windows introduces an All Accounts view, allowing users to see and manage emails from multiple accounts in a single inbox without merging mailboxes. It supports AI-assisted workflows with Copilot. Rollout began in September 2026, completing by November. No admin action is currently needed.

items.title: MC1530612: Microsoft 365 admin center: Pin Microsoft Copilot app setting for users with a paid Microsoft 365 Copilot license
items.summary: Microsoft 365 admin center updates the Copilot taskbar pinning setting to allow pinning only for users with a paid Copilot license, removing the default "Do not pin" selection. Rollout starts December 2026. Admins must have Microsoft Entra group creation permissions to use the new option.

items.summary: Office in Copilot integrates Word, Excel, and PowerPoint into the Microsoft Copilot app, enabling users to create, edit, and collaborate on files without leaving the app. Rolling out worldwide in mid-November 2026, it requires no admin action but is managed via existing Copilot policies and Entra ID controls.

items.title: MC1529467: Microsoft Windows: Updates to address compromised eMudhra certificate authority keys
items.summary: Microsoft is updating Windows, Edge, and WebView2 to block eight compromised eMudhra certificate authority keys by late October 2026. Organizations must allow automatic updates, manage disconnected devices, and replace certificates chaining to these keys to maintain trust and security.

items.title: MC1529463: Microsoft Entra ID: Final reminder to replace MemberOf rule operator configurations by November 3, 2026
items.summary: Microsoft Entra ID will retire the MemberOf rule operator by November 3, 2026. Organizations using MemberOf in dynamic groups, administrative units, or entitlement policies must replace it to avoid outdated memberships, access, and licensing issues. Action is required before this date to maintain proper functionality.

items.title: MC1519871: Copilot Code is rolling out in Frontier
items.summary: Copilot Code, an AI-powered coding tool in Microsoft Copilot, is rolling out in the Frontier program starting late October 2026. It enables users with licenses and spending policies to build, refine, and publish apps using natural language, with admin-controlled usage-based billing and optional local coding on PC.

items.summary: Microsoft 365 admin center introduces a preview usage report for managing metered costs of Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat pay-as-you-go billing. items.summary: Microsoft Purview Endpoint DLP will protect sensitive files in previously excluded Windows folders (e.g., AppData) during egress actions starting late February 2027. SMS for MFA and password reset remains unaffected. Admins should review usage, notify users, and ensure alternate sign-in methods.

items.title: MC1528007: Join button will require HTTPS meeting links
items.summary: Starting late November 2026, Outlook's Join button will only appear for meetings with HTTPS join URLs. Meetings with HTTP-only URLs will not show the button. Organizations should ensure their meeting providers and integrations generate HTTPS links to avoid impact. No action is needed if HTTPS URLs are already used.

items.title: MC1528006: Microsoft Authenticator: Improved backup and restore experience for Android
items.summary: Microsoft Authenticator for Android will improve backup and restore with clearer setup guidance and support for passkeys starting mid-January 2027. Users must enable Google One backup and screen lock. Work/school accounts aren’t backed up, and backup works only in the Android personal profile. No admin action needed.

items.summary: Edit with Copilot in Excel on iPhone enables natural language editing and task continuation outside the app. Rolling out worldwide from late October to November 2026, it enhances mobile Excel use with secure Microsoft 365 integration, allowing quick data insights, edits, and formula updates without compliance concerns.
